topic: What is STEM? Introduction to Technologies and the STEM Lab

slides.title:
Session 1: What is STEM?
Introduction to Technologies and the STEM Lab
slides.speaker_notes: Welcome students to their first ENpower STEM Lab session. Build excitement about exploring STEM fields and connecting to Indian achievements.
slides.graphics_description: ENpower logo with purple and gold branding. Background shows diverse Indian students in a modern lab setting with STEM equipment. Include tagline 'THINK . CREATE . LEAD.'

slides.title: India Reaches the Moon!
bullets: Chandrayaan-3 successfully landed on the Moon in 2023
India became the 4th country to achieve this amazing feat
Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam inspired generations as 'Missile Man of India'
How do you think scientists made this possible?
slides.speaker_notes: Use this hook to generate excitement about STEM. Ask students what they know about space missions and connect to the upcoming STEM concepts.
slides.graphics_description: Split image showing Chandrayaan-3 spacecraft and a respectful illustration of Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam. Include Indian flag and space imagery with cartoon-style graphics.

slides.title: What Does STEM Mean?
bullets: S = Science (studying how things work)
T = Technology (tools and machines that help us)
E = Engineering (designing and building solutions)
M = Mathematics (numbers and patterns)
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce each component with simple definitions. Ask students to think of examples for each letter before revealing the next slide.
slides.graphics_description: Large colorful letters S-T-E-M with simple icons: microscope for Science, computer for Technology, gears for Engineering, calculator for Mathematics. Use bright, engaging colors.

slides.title: STEM Examples Around Us
bullets: Science: Weather prediction helps farmers plan crops
Technology: Mobile apps connect people across India
Engineering: Metro trains make city travel faster
Mathematics: Cricket statistics help teams win matches
slides.speaker_notes: Connect STEM to familiar Indian contexts. Encourage students to share their own examples from daily life.
slides.graphics_description: Four panels showing: weather satellite over Indian farmland, smartphone with Indian app icons, Delhi Metro train, cricket scoreboard with statistics. Cartoon-style, colorful illustrations.

slides.title: STEM Fields Work Together
bullets: Scientists discover new knowledge about our world
Engineers use science to design helpful solutions
Technology helps us build and test these solutions
Mathematics helps us measure and improve everything
slides.speaker_notes: Emphasize how STEM fields collaborate. Use the moon mission example - scientists studied space, engineers designed the rocket, technology built it, math calculated the path.
slides.graphics_description: Circular diagram showing four STEM fields connected with arrows, demonstrating collaboration. Include diverse Indian students working together in the center.

slides.title: STEM Detective Hunt
bullets: Look around our lab and find STEM tools
Work with your partner to identify each tool
Guess which STEM field uses each tool
Share your discoveries with the class
slides.speaker_notes: Give students 5-7 minutes to explore the lab safely. Provide a simple worksheet to record findings. Circulate to guide and ensure safety.
slides.graphics_description: Cartoon detective with magnifying glass surrounded by lab equipment icons: beakers, rulers, computers, building blocks. Include diverse student pairs exploring.

slides.title: Our STEM Lab Tools
bullets: Measuring tools: rulers, scales, thermometers
Building materials: blocks, wires, batteries
Technology: computers, tablets, sensors
Safety equipment: goggles, gloves, first aid kit
slides.speaker_notes: Show actual lab tools as you discuss each category. Demonstrate proper handling and emphasize that safety equipment protects everyone.
slides.graphics_description: Grid layout showing actual lab tools with clear labels. Include safety equipment prominently. Use bright, clear photography with cartoon-style borders.

slides.title: Lab Safety Rules
bullets: Always listen to instructions before starting
Wear safety goggles when working with materials
Keep your workspace clean and organized
Ask for help if you're unsure about anything
slides.speaker_notes: Practice each safety rule with students. Have them repeat the rules back and explain why each one is important for everyone's safety.
slides.graphics_description: Four panels showing students demonstrating each safety rule. Include diverse Indian students wearing safety equipment properly. Use positive, encouraging imagery.

slides.title: Good Lab Etiquette
bullets: Share materials and take turns respectfully
Use quiet voices so everyone can concentrate
Clean up your area when finished
Help classmates when they need support
slides.speaker_notes: Discuss why good behavior helps everyone learn better. Role-play examples of good and poor etiquette to make concepts clear.
slides.graphics_description: Students demonstrating good lab behavior: sharing equipment, working quietly, cleaning up, helping each other. Show positive interactions between diverse students.

slides.title: STEM in My Life Map
bullets: Draw or write about STEM in your daily life
Include examples from home, school, and community
Connect each example to S, T, E, or M
Share one interesting discovery with a friend
slides.speaker_notes: Provide large paper and colored pencils. Encourage creativity - students can draw, write, or use both. Walk around to help students make connections.
slides.graphics_description: Template showing a simple mind map with 'My Life' in the center and branches for Home, School, Community. Include small STEM icons and diverse student examples.

slides.title: Indian STEM Innovations
bullets: UPI payments make shopping easier for millions
Aadhaar system helps identify every Indian citizen
Indian Railways uses technology to connect the country
ISRO space missions inspire the world
slides.speaker_notes: Connect these innovations to STEM fields. Ask students which STEM areas contributed to each innovation. Build pride in Indian achievements.
slides.graphics_description: Four icons representing each innovation: UPI payment symbol, Aadhaar logo, train, rocket. Use Indian flag colors and include diverse people benefiting from each innovation.

slides.title: What We Learned Today
bullets: STEM means Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics
These four fields work together to solve problems
Lab safety rules keep everyone protected
Good etiquette helps everyone learn better
slides.speaker_notes: Review key concepts and ask students to share their favorite discovery from today. Preview next session's exciting activities.
slides.graphics_description: Summary graphic with STEM letters, safety icons, and happy diverse students in lab coats. Include ENpower branding and 'THINK . CREATE . LEAD.' tagline.
